munit:test.name: portal-view-matches-the-assignment-step-6
munit:test.description: On 2026-10-15 the Process response of step 5 becomes exactly the portal view of step 6 (age 41)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toPortalPatient from dwl::PortalView output application/json --- toPortalPatient(readUrl("classpath://samples/process-patient-case1.json", "application/json"), |2026-10-15|)

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #[{ patientId: 'PAT-000123', fullName: 'Ana Kovač', age: 41, category: 'ADULT', email: 'ana.kovac@example.com', phone: '+38761111222', status: 'ACTIVE', registeredAt: '2026-10-15T10:21:07Z' } orderBy $$]

munit:test.name: downstream-and-error-catalogue-are-consistent
munit:test.description: Lower-API answers keep their code; transient HTTP errors and exhausted retries are 502

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import errorCodeFor from dwl::Downstream import codeFor, statusFor from dwl::ApiErrors output application/json fun body(code) = { error: { code: code } } --- { downstream: [ errorCodeFor(200, {}), errorCodeFor(404, body("PATIENT_NOT_FOUND")), errorCodeFor(422, body("CONSENT_REQUIRED")), errorCodeFor(502, body("DOWNSTREAM_ERROR")), errorCodeFor(503, "Service Unavailable") ], statuses: [ statusFor(codeFor({ namespace: "MULE", identifier: "RETRY_EXHAUSTED" })), statusFor(codeFor({ namespace: "APP", identifier: "PATIENT_NOT_FOUND" })), statusFor(codeFor({ namespace: "APIKIT", identifier: "BAD_REQUEST" })) ] }

munit:test.name: log-event-is-a-single-line-json-object
munit:test.description: LogEvent.event: event name and correlation ID first, then the fields, on one line

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import event, elapsedMillis from dwl::LogEvent output application/json var message = event("response.sent", "cid-1", { status: 201, path: "/api/patients" }) --- { message: message, parsed: read(message, "application/json"), oneLine: not (message contains "\n"), elapsedIsNonNegative: elapsedMillis(now() as Number { unit: "milliseconds" }) >= 0 }

munit:test.name: idempotency-fingerprint-ignores-key-order-only
munit:test.description: The same JSON in another key order has the same fingerprint; any value change gives another

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #[{ same: true, changed: false, format: true }]

munit:test.name: idempotency-decisions
munit:test.description: Replay a completed request, reject another body, block a running one, claim an expired or abandoned entry

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import completedEntry, decide, inProgressEntry from dwl::Idempotency output application/json var at = |2026-10-19T12:00:00Z| var minute = 60000 --- { replay: decide(completedEntry("h1", 201, "/api/patients/PAT-000001", { patientId: "PAT-000001" }, at), "h1", at, minute), mismatch: decide(completedEntry("h1", 201, "/api/patients/PAT-000001", {}, at), "h2", at, minute), running: decide(inProgressEntry("h1", at), "h1", at + |PT30S|, minute), abandoned: decide(inProgressEntry("h1", at), "h1", at + |PT2M|, minute), otherBody: decide(inProgressEntry("h1", at), "h2", at + |PT30S|, minute), absent: decide({ state: "ABSENT" }, "h1", at, minute), storedBody: completedEntry("h1", 201, "/x", { b: 1, a: "č" }, at).body }

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #[{ replay: 'REPLAY', mismatch: 'MISMATCH', running: 'IN_PROGRESS', abandoned: 'CLAIM', otherBody: 'MISMATCH', absent: 'CLAIM' }]
